subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Recognise and say twelve shop names.
Match shops to the things you can buy there.
Sort shops into groups like food, clothes and presents.

tf.s: You can buy meat at the butcher's.
You can buy fish at the greengrocer's.
tf.why: We buy fish at the fishmonger's. The greengrocer's sells fruit and vegetables.

tf.s: You can buy medicine at the pharmacy.
You can buy newspapers, magazines and snacks at the kiosk.
tf.why: A kiosk sells newspapers, magazines and snacks.
A jeweller's sells things like necklaces. Footballs are at the sports shop.

tf.s: The greengrocer's belongs to the food group.
tf.why: It sells fruit and vegetables, which are food.

tf.s: You can buy a present for your granny at the gift shop.
You buy boots at the toy shop.
tf.why: You buy boots at the shoe shop.

tf.s: A spider web can help you sort new words into groups.
tf.why: Spider webs help us organise words.

boxes.q: Medicine? You buy it at the ______.
boxes.why: We buy medicine at the pharmacy.

boxes.q: Choose: My mum often goes to the (pharmacy / kiosk) to buy a magazine.
I need to buy a necklace for my sister. We'll go to the ______.
Where can you buy a football?
Where can you buy a new phone case?
boxes.why: A phone shop sells phone cases.

boxes.q: Which shop sells apples and bananas?
boxes.why: The greengrocer's sells fruit and vegetables.

boxes.q: Which group does the butcher's belong to?
boxes.why: The butcher's sells meat, which is food.

boxes.q: Where can you buy a doll or a toy car?

mcq.q: Which shop sells newspapers, magazines and snacks?
What can you buy at the fishmonger's?
Choose: Yesterday, we went to the (butcher's / shoe shop) to buy some meat.
mcq.why: Meat is sold at the butcher's.

mcq.q: Correct the sentence: On Saturdays, my dad goes to the fishmonger's to buy some fruit.
o: … to the greengrocer's to buy some fruit.
… to the pharmacy to buy some fruit.
… to the jeweller's to buy some fruit.
… to the shoe shop to buy some fruit.
mcq.why: We buy fruit at the greengrocer's.

mcq.q: You want to buy a present for your granny. Where will you go?
Which group has only food shops?
o: shoe shop, sports shop, toy shop

mcq.q: Which shop is the odd one out?
mcq.why: The others sell food, but the shoe shop sells shoes.

mcq.q: You need a necklace for your sister. Which two shops can you try?
o: the jeweller's or the gift shop
the shoe shop or the sports shop
mcq.why: Both sell things you can give as presents, like necklaces.
